query:
SELECT 
                gs.score,
                gs.time_spent,
                u.id as user_id,
                u.username,
                u.nickname as "nickname?",
                u.avatar as "avatar?"
            FROM game_scores gs
            JOIN users u ON gs.user_id = u.id
            WHERE gs.user_id = $1 AND gs.game_type = $2 AND gs.level = $3
            ORDER BY gs.score DESC, gs.time_spent ASC
            LIMIT 1
